messages:
jordan (pm): FYI — ACME asked to push SSO from MVP into v1. they said SSO is required to sign the pilot contract if we can deliver it in the first quarter after launch. wondering if we should accept and adjust the milestone or push back.
nana (product): That's a big ask. If we move SSO to v1, what's the minimum for MVP to satisfy the pilot?
sam (eng): Practically speaking, SSO adds ~3 sprint work: idp integrations + e2e testing + infra certs. If we cut it, we can keep other telemetry and taxonomies.
liyah (design): From UX: we can ship a 'lite' login flow for MVP (email + magic link) and reserve full SSO screens for v1. That saves some design + PM time.
mike (eng-infra): Note: SSO requires some KMS access and a shortlist of compliance docs for ACME. If we defer we still need a path for certs; timeline for certs is ~4 weeks after kickoff.
alex-cs (customer success): ACME said pilot is conditional — they'll start onboarding if SSO is in v1 within 6 weeks post-launch. They prefer pilot ASAP though, so they might accept a limited MVP with magic link.
jordan (pm): Options: A) Accept move SSO->v1, keep timeline; B) Hold SSO in MVP, push other noncritical features to v1; C) Ask ACME to delay pilot start until SSO. Thoughts?
sam (eng): A reduces risk to launch velocity. B increases scope and might slip launch by 2 weeks. C likely kills pilot momentum.
nana (product): My leaning is A but we need to make it explicit in contracts. Also define the 'noncritical features' we can cut if we pick B.
liyah (design): If we pick A, we should still ship clear placeholders and a roadmap callout in the UI: "SSO (coming in v1)" so enterprise users understand.
mike (eng-infra): If A, devops work can be scheduled into Dedicated infra sprint after launch. we should still reserve an IP allowlist for ACME during pilot.
alex-cs (customer success): I can push back lightly with ACME: offer magic-link MVP + documented SSO timeline (v1 within 6 weeks). If they insist, I need a decision by EOD.
jordan (pm): Quick risk summary: A (defer SSO) = preserves MVP deadline, less eng work before launch, contractual commitment required; B (keep SSO) = +2w risk to launch; C (delay pilot) = loses momentum.
sam (eng): Also call out: if we defer SSO, we should add a canary/feature-flag path so when we flip we can onboard ACME without redeploy.
nana (product): Action items: 1) alex to give ACME the magic-link + SSO timeline option; 2) sam & mike to draft a minimal infra checklist for v1 SSO; 3) liyah to add placeholder UI copy; 4) jordan to update milestone doc and communicate to execs.
alex-cs (customer success): I'll draft the ACME reply now and loop them into a short sync. target to send by 5pm PT.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance reminder: prod deployment window tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PT. flagging for visibility. :warning:
jordan (pm): Okay let's treat decision as A (defer SSO to v1) unless someone calls it out before 5pm. I'll update the milestone tracker:
```
MILESTONE: MVP-launch: 2026-04-15
v1 SSO kickoff (target): 2026-04-22
Pilot onboarding window (ACME): 2026-04-22 -> 2026-06-01
Cutlist: remove 'enterprise SSO' from MVP, keep magic-link, keep telemetry
```
sam (eng): I'll kick off the infra checklist PR and tag @mike.
mike (eng-infra): noted. will prep KMS/allowlist docs and a deploy plan for the v1 flip.
liyah (design): I'll drop placeholder copy into the prototype and link it in the ticket.
nana (product): thanks all — tagging this as 'scope-decision: defer SSO' in the milestone doc. jordan, can you make the communication to sales/legal for contract language?
jordan (pm): yes. I'll create a short update and share with execs + sales. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
